# DeepScreen

> DeepScreen is a global stock screener and research platform covering NSE, BSE, NYSE, Nasdaq and LSE with a transparent 13-factor fundamental model.

Canonical site: https://deepscreen.online/
Contact: deepscreen.online@outlook.com

## Primary tools
- [Global stock screener](https://deepscreen.online/): Cross-exchange stock discovery and rankings.
- [Options strategy lab](https://deepscreen.online/options): Black-Scholes Greeks and multi-leg payoff analysis.
- [IPO calendar](https://deepscreen.online/ipo): India, US and UK IPO pipeline.
- [Market calendar](https://deepscreen.online/calendar): Earnings, dividends and economic events.

## Research documentation
- [Methodology](https://deepscreen.online/methodology): Factors, weighting, sources and limitations.
- [Ratio glossary](https://deepscreen.online/learn): Definitions and formulas for all 13 model factors, Piotroski F-Score, Altman Z-Score and Beneish M-Score.
- [Learning centre](https://deepscreen.online/learn): Plain-English investing and trading guides.
- [About](https://deepscreen.online/about): Purpose, coverage and editorial principles.

## Important context
- DeepScreen scores are analytical model outputs, not investment advice.
- Core ratios, scores and verdicts are open and crawlable. Pro gates interpretation tools, not the underlying numbers.
- When a required source field is unavailable, DeepScreen prefers “Insufficient data” over inventing a value.
- Indian filing ratios may be sourced from Screener.in. Other supported markets use available Yahoo Finance data.
- Verify material figures against primary company disclosures before relying on them.
